1. (Currently amended) A composition comprising:
a) an active ingredient comprising an indole compound of formula I;
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles; and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action;
wherein said composition is formulated for topical application to treat acne vulgaris.

3. (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising:
a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1;
b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles; and
c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action.

4. (Currently amended) The composition according to Claim 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 per cent by weight to 10 per cent by weight.

5. (Currently amended) The composition according to Claim 1, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight.

7. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition for treatment of acne vulgaris.

8. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition suitable for treatment of acne vulgaris, acne comedonica, polymorphic acne, acne rosaceae, nodular acne, acne conglobata, age-related acne, acne occurring as a side effect such as acne solaris, medicament-related acne or acne professionalis.

9. (Currently amended) The use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development in subjects with acne-related hair conditions.

10. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of the general state of the skin or hair affected by acne or related keratinization disorders.

12. (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for treatment of skin conditions associated with acne or defective keratinization.

13. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles, fine lines, rough skin or large-pored skin resulting from acne or acne scarring.

14. (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the treatment of skin damage caused by acne, including reduction of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and post-acne scarring.
